definition: the central part of a wheel, around the axle
description: In a bike workshop a young man in an apron holds a tiny white scooter wheel right up to the camera so its dark metal centre and bearing fill the frame. He then swings a blue bicycle upside down and spins its front wheel, and the camera drops low to follow the tyre and the silver centre with its spokes fanning out. Next he walks up to a huge black tractor tyre on a yellow rim taller than he is and stares at its bolted centre. Finally the camera tilts up at a giant ferris wheel against a blue sky, its spokes running out from the white centre, with the tractor tyre still in the bottom of the shot.

en.question: What is the man staring at?

de.answer: Er starrt einen riesigen Traktorreifen an.
de.question: Was starrt der Mann an?

es.answer: Está mirando fijamente un enorme neumático de tractor.
